steps.label: MANAGE PERMISSIONS PANEL
steps.sub: opened from the item itself, not workspace settings

caption: Links that give access, and a separate "People with direct access" list — independent of the workspace's own role assignments.
The Permissions column spells out exactly what each grant includes, rather than a single opaque role name.
Role shows what's inherited from the workspace; Permissions shows what's granted on this one item.
Read is implied by sharing at all; Additional permissions checkboxes layer on exactly what's needed, nothing more.
